page: Amazon Web Services c7i-flex.12xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor and an Intel Xeon 8488C processor. This x86_64 architecture server features 48 virtual CPUs mapped to 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 96.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory operating at 5 GHz, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. The processor includes a 105 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as Intel Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated matrix and vector operations. No local storage or dedicated GPUs are bundled with this instance.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong performance across multiple domains. The instance achieves top-tier results in LLM inference text generation for small models, alongside strong top-25% ratings in Geekbench multi-core, software compilation, and ray tracing. Memory bandwidth tests show strong performance, reaching 4111.32 GB/sec for cached reads and 222.1 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and static web serving throughput also rank in the top 25%, while stress-ng CPU performance and Redis SET operations fall within the average range.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c7i-flex family offers a balanced, utility-oriented compute profile, delivering high-density DDR5 memory and advanced Intel instruction sets without the premium of local NVMe storage. This makes it highly suitable for compute-intensive workloads that do not require local ephemeral disks. Optimal workloads include software compilation, database operations, static web serving, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
